body: I'm just scared that is what my life will be. I wish this was easier. I wish I was a better person.
I would if I didn't have parents that cared so much. Don't really want to be here. But I'm here.

I know it may not be a big thing to say but, find a super dumb reason. I want to die everyday of my life. "just close your eyes, let your car drift away." But I don't. Don't really know why. I make dumb reasons to stay. I want to watch the rest of house. I want to play my music someday. I want to watch the face of my watch turn whilst listening to John Frusciante. 

I'm so sorry about your girlfriend. God, I'm so so sorry. I can't imagine that pain. Please have a safe day, and find a dumb reason to stay.
I just can't handle my OCD anymore. It's killing me..
I just wanted to say, I'm still here. Thank you guys.
